tries to prefetch 4 S/G table entries (since SGF bit is set

the SEQ OUT PTR is ""dummy"" (set to zero / not obtained via DMA API
mapping).

column2: avoid the IOMMU fault by clearing the SGF bit

column1: in SEQ OUT PTR command.

column2: Input address = Y. A unspecified frame is
